x-intellij-html-description:
Entity Action Type

Summons a minion entity with customisable settings. Minions are tamed entities with a maximum age, after which they will die. They have no other AI by default.

Fields

Field Type Default Description
texture Identifier proviorigins:textures/entity/minion_template.png The texture that the minion will have.
follow_owner Boolean Whether or not the minion will follow the player.
follow_offset Vector {"x": 0, "y": 0, "z":0} The local-coordinate offset that a follower minion will stay relevant to the player. This also affects the offset from which the minion is summoned relative to the player.
scale Float 1.0 The size multiplier of the minion.
invulnerable Boolean false Whether or not the minion is immune to damage.
max_life_ticks Integer 1200 The maximum age of the minion, the minion will die after this amount of time. Negative values are treated as infinite duration.
bientity_action Bientity Action Optional This bientity action is triggered after the minion is spawned. The summoner is the actor and the minion is the target.

Minion Specifications

  • Minions have 20 health (10 hearts).
  • Minions are living entities and thus can receive Origins/Apoli powers.
  • A follower minion has a constant offset from the player.
  • Minions cannot be pushed.
  • Follower minions will kill themselves if their owner does not exist or is in another dimensions.
  • Minions cannot use portals.
  • Follower minions will look in the same direction as the player.

The minion model consists of 3 cubes and 3 planes. The cubes are inside of each other, they are layered. The planes intersect the minion through the middle.
